summary: Successfully implemented KAFKA-20282: Added log recommendation for KIP-848 consumer rebalance protocol. Modified ClassicKafkaConsumer constructor to log "The consumer rebalance protocol (KIP-848) is production ready!" when a group ID is configured. All four test cases pass (testClassicProtocolLogsRecommendationToTryConsumerProtocol, testConsumerProtocolDoesNotLogRecommendation, testDefaultProtocolLogsRecommendationToTryConsumerProtocol, testNoGroupIdDoesNotLogGroupProtocolMessage) with no regressions in full test suite.
